{"schema_version":1,"triplet_id":"ft_mp_parse_787468773c9f","entrypoint":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","input_strategy":{"description":"Decode the fuzz input as a bounded sequence of MP frames. Each frame is 8-byte header plus payload. The harness assembles frames from fuzz bytes, repairing payload_length and checksum, and calls mp_parse once per frame with the mp_context kept alive across frames.","data_identifier":"data","size_identifier":"size","bounded_steps":32,"notes":["Each frame consumes 1 byte opcode plus up to MP_MAX_PAYLOAD payload bytes from the fuzz input.","payload_length is computed by the harness from the number of payload bytes actually available for the frame, not read from the fuzz input.","checksum is computed by the harness over the payload using mp_checksum and written little-endian at offset 6.","magic0='M', magic1='P', version=1 are written by the harness at offsets 0,1,2.","The mp_context is initialized once per LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput call and destroyed at the end of the iteration."]},"state_objects":[{"name":"ctx","type":"mp_context","initialization":"mp_init(&ctx) at the start of LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput; destroyed via mp_destroy(&ctx) after the frame loop."},{"name":"frame_buf","type":"uint8_t[MP_HEADER_SIZE + MP_MAX_PAYLOAD]","initialization":"Zero-initialized per frame; header fields written by harness, payload copied from fuzz bytes."}],"call_sequence":[{"function":"mp_init","roles":["HPF"],"purpose":"Initialize the mp_context once per fuzz iteration so state persists across all frames decoded from this input.","arguments":["&ctx"],"uses_fuzzer_data":false,"uses_fuzzer_size":false,"outputs":["ctx"],"conditions":["called once at the start of LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput"]},{"function":"mp_parse","roles":["ISF","PRF"],"purpose":"Parse one assembled MP frame; called once per frame in the bounded multi-frame loop. Uses fuzzer data and size for the frame bytes.","arguments":["&ctx","frame_buf","frame_len"],"uses_fuzzer_data":true,"uses_fuzzer_size":true,"outputs":["return status"],"conditions":["frame_len >= MP_HEADER_SIZE","payload_length <= MP_MAX_PAYLOAD","checksum matches mp_checksum(payload, payload_length)"]}],"cleanup_sequence":[{"function":"mp_destroy","purpose":"Release any state held by the mp_context after all frames have been processed in this iteration.","arguments":["&ctx"],"after":["mp_parse"]}],"constraints":["mp_parse requires size >= MP_HEADER_SIZE (8).","payload_length must equal size - MP_HEADER_SIZE and must be <= MP_MAX_PAYLOAD.","checksum at offset 6 (little-endian) must equal mp_checksum(payload, payload_length).","magic bytes at offsets 0 and 1 must be 'M' and 'P'; version at offset 2 must be 1.","opcode at offset 3 selects dispatch among 7 cases (values 1..7).","mp_context must be initialized once per iteration and destroyed after the frame loop."],"notes":["mp_parse is both ISF and PRF; it is placed in call_sequence and its cleanup responsibility is handled by mp_destroy in cleanup_sequence.","mp_destroy is HPF and is placed in cleanup_sequence after all mp_parse calls.","The harness repairs payload_length and checksum for every frame; fuzz input only controls opcode and payload bytes.","Stateful opcodes MP_STORE, MP_USE, MP_RELEASE are exercised by fuzz-chosen opcodes across frames within one iteration."],"protocol_contract_bindings":{"context":{"destroy":"mp_destroy","init":"mp_init","lifetime":"per_iteration","type":"mp_context"},"frame":{"fields":[{"name":"magic0","offset":0,"role":"magic","value":"'M'","width":1},{"name":"magic1","offset":1,"role":"magic","value":"'P'","width":1},{"name":"version","offset":2,"role":"version","value":"1","width":1},{"name":"opcode","offset":3,"role":"opcode","width":1},{"endianness":"little_endian","name":"payload_length","offset":4,"role":"payload_length","width":2},{"endianness":"little_endian","name":"checksum","offset":6,"role":"checksum","width":2},{"name":"payload","offset":8,"role":"payload","width":"payload_length"}],"header_size":8,"max_payload":64,"max_payload_symbol":"MP_MAX_PAYLOAD","payload_offset":8},"helpers":["le16","mp_checksum","mp_destroy","mp_init","mp_parse"],"input_model":{"bounded_multi_frame":true,"bounded_steps":32,"bounded_steps_source":"engineering_choice","payload_fuzzer_controlled":true,"repair_checksum":true,"repair_length":true},"stateful_operations":["MP_RELEASE","MP_STORE","MP_USE"]}}
